events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 21 (today)): Adam added Savion Williams (WR, GB) (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, WAS)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 20 (yesterday)): Drew added Pierre Strong (RB, GB) for $25 FAAB (dropped CJ Daniels (WR, LAR)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 18 (3 days ago)): Charles added Jarrett Stidham (QB, DEN) (dropped Isaiah Williams (WR, NYJ)).
CUT (Oct 17 (4 days ago)): Corbishley released Jacob Saylors (RB, DET).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 17 (4 days ago)): Corbishley added Tanner McKee (QB, PHI) (dropped Carson Wentz (QB, MIN)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 16 (5 days ago)): Kevin added Jahan Dotson (WR, ATL).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 14 (7 days ago)): Drew added Brandin Cooks (WR, SF) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).

WEEK 6 RESULTS: Fronge def. Corbishley, 103.8-88.3; Charles def. Adam, 136.8-112.3; Brent def. Drew, 132.3-57.5 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Shaq, 113.8-101.9; Kevin def. Wingard, 114.3-59.7 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Ryan, 149.1-122.1

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Adam dropped Austin Ekeler and added Savion Williams this morning. The move is not the headline — the headline is that Helix is 2-10 and faces Atlas at 0-12 this week, and Adam is still tinkering with the RB room like there is a playoff push being managed here. There is not.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4 on the season, locks 2-0, and nobody is going to give me thirty seconds on the preview show to talk about the Jake vs Kevin game this week. Fine. I'll do it here. EchoPoint is 6-6 with a real RB backfield and Redline just demolished Wingard by 54.6 points. That is a playoff-seeding game dressed up as a Wednesday night conversation. Someone put it on the board.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 and fully aware of it. I'm not going to pretend the ledger looks healthy right now. What I will say is that Mitchum at 149.1 points in a week where Deepwater lost to Ryan is the most confusing production line in this league — 861.6 PF on the season, fourth overall, and somehow that firm is 8-4 instead of 10-2. The schedule has not been kind and neither has my pick-em record, so maybe Mitchum and I are the same company.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Drew added Pierre Strong for $25 FAAB yesterday and dropped CJ Daniels, and the week before that added Brandin Cooks and dropped Joe Mixon. That is not roster construction. That is a man rearranging furniture in a house that is structurally condemned. ATLAS is at $35.28 and the transactions are not going to move that number.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Fronge angle all week and the score was 103.8-88.3 from Havana. Season record is 7-5 and the locks are 1-1, which I acknowledge, but the directional call on ForgeHammer was correct and that is what I want on the tape. Now Fronge draws Ryan in Week 7 and I am not fading them a second time.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Corbishley vs Shaq this week and I think people are sleeping on MWB. Monarch is up 5.1% to $97.65 on the exchange, the squad just pushed Jake to 113.8-101.9 in a loss — that is a competitive score — and Apex is rattled after dropping one to a 5-7 team in Cuba. The Tanner McKee move does not inspire confidence in that QB room heading into a game Corbishley needs badly.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger is going to have a very specific question for the exchange board Friday morning: Charles has been at or above $145 all window and is 12-0 against a schedule that includes Wingard this week. At what point does CROWN stop sliding — even a little — and start getting priced like the undefeated firm it actually is? The $146.42 number is not reflecting what the scoreboard says.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The power rankings will be updated before Friday and yes, I am aware that Mitchum is going to be a difficult placement. 8-4 with 861.6 PF is a legitimate case for top four. The loss to Ryan last week is a legitimate case against it. The model does not care about either argument — it cares about the number — so stop asking me to justify it before I run it.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: WINGARD IS AT $54.08, TOOK A 114.3-59.7 LOSS TO KEVIN LAST WEEK, IS 3-9 ON THE SEASON, AND NOW GETS CHARLES IN WEEK 7. SOVEREIGN DRAFT RESERVE HAS FUTURE PICKS. THAT IS IT. THAT IS THE ENTIRE ASSET BASE. THE PRODUCTION DISCOUNT ON THOSE PICKS IS WIDENING IN REAL TIME AND THIS WEEK IS GOING TO MAKE IT WORSE.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: 7-5, locks 2-0, and Terrence is at 5-7 talking about furniture rearrangement when he should be talking about his own ledger. I respect the self-awareness but the accountability segment runs both directions. Odom has missed more games than he's hit in the last three weeks and the board sees it.
